name: UX Collective
summary: Independent design publication on Medium with curated stories on UX, visual and product design.
description: UX Collective is an independent design publication and blog hosted on Medium (ISSN 2766-5267). It curates stories on user experience, visual and product design for designers, organised by topics such as UX, design, artificial intelligence, technology and product, with editor picks and a yearly archive back to 2013; readers can follow it, take the newsletter or submit a story.
